name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Sales & Customer Onboarding | New Business, Implementation & Compliance-Minded Operations
summary: SaaS account executive and onboarding specialist with 15+ years selling to local business owners and then getting them live on the software. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled, closing deals of $20K+ and building the implementation plan behind each one. At Wix, carried a combined sales and implementation load, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while onboarding 25+ clients a month. Co-owned and ran a licensed, regulated business in Colorado, building its compliance, intake, and reporting systems from scratch. Detail-driven in account setup and in the CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce), and Denver based near a major hub airport.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Prospect, pitch, and close local service businesses (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other trades), using a free no-cost audit as the conversation opener to surface problems and show value before any pricing talk.
Run discovery, onboarding, and hands-on training for every new client, configuring their accounts and getting owners and staff using the system.
Document every prospect, meeting, deliverable, and next step in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, keeping pipeline and project records current across concurrent engagements.
Expand retainer scope by identifying under-served needs after onboarding and scoping complementary services.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts and ran QBRs, resolving client feedback quickly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Sold and onboarded 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) on Birdeye's listings, reputation, and automation software, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network and guided customers through detailed technical setup and configuration.
Passed structured field feedback on customer needs and objections to Product and Engineering, informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K (several over $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings, while leading the sales team.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Carried a combined sales and onboarding load, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while launching 25+ clients per month.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for two years (20, later 8), and standardized the CRM fields the team used to capture sales and onboarding data.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, consistently earning into accelerator tiers.
Averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue, with deals of $20K+ later in tenure.

bullets: Ran full-cycle sales to local SMB owners for a loyalty and marketing platform: high-volume prospecting, qualification, demos, and close.
